artifact: Citation historical logic disposition for Citation Support Runtime V1

items.basis: Citation candidates must remain inside the already frozen retrieval result.
Runtime V1 validates Evidence provenance directly against Retriever V1 metadata.
Useful engineering concept, but Runtime V1 requires exact traceability back to raw frozen chunk text.
Multiple chunks from one canonical source must aggregate without deleting required-point support.
Runtime V1 has no answer and must not create answer claims.
It ranks relevance and does not validate Evidence provenance or entailment.
Recorded as unreliable for entailment with 20/20 hard-negative false-positive anchors at the selected threshold.
No completed human citation labels; labels were produced by the evaluated rules themselves.
A rule pass rate cannot be reported as human citation correctness.
